subject: Proposed Residential Zoning District Amendments
overview: The Community Development Board approved a covenant and endorsed plans for the Bridal Path subdivision, and held a lengthy public hearing regarding proposed amendments to the city's residential zoning districts and map.

items.title: Bridal Path Subdivision Covenant and Plan Endorsement
items.summary: Approved the Bridal Path subdivision covenant pending city legal counsel approval and endorsed the definitive subdivision plan.

items.title: Proposed Residential Zoning Ordinance and Map Amendments Public Hearing
items.summary: Heard a presentation on proposed residential zoning district additions and dimensional standards, received extensive public comments, and voted to continue the hearing to April 16, 2025.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for March 5, 2025, and March 19, 2025.
